verdicts.reason: A breaks the headline along the phrase (KEEP CALM / AND / GET A CAT), so it reads naturally, but the lone 'AND' line is a weak middle beat. Its cat cluster has a hard flat bottom edge that floats above the canvas edge instead of bleeding off it like the original, and the top cat's ears nearly touch the top edge. B makes the same illustration mistake (flat cropped base floating above the bottom, cramped at the top) and splits 'KEEP' from 'CALM', leaving an orphaned 'KEEP' that breaks up the slogan, so A is slightly better.
